old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-0919","title":"Gateway rollback floors share the rollback domain with protected state","description":"Security review finding: lichend places gateway-trust.bin and gateway-trust.generation together under state_root, and likewise gateway-slot-replay.bin with gateway-slot-replay.generation. The code/documentation calls each floor independent/monotonic, but both are ordinary atomically-renamed files in the same directory. Restoring one filesystem snapshot rolls back the sealed record and its minimum together, so TrustStore::load and SlotClaimVerifier::load accept the old valid signature/generation. This can resurrect removed/rotated gateway trust and permit previously consumed slot claims after reboot.
